request.context: We are extending a research code for primordial H, D, He chemical kinetics. The immediate mathematical task is to tabulate positive temperature-only rate coefficients without changing their native source model. We need to derive log-temperature/log-rate interpolation bounds on a single smooth formula branch, keep exact zeros and branch boundaries, and propagate coefficient perturbations through density factored reaction channels. We will symbolically differentiate astrophysical Arrhenius-like and rational recombination fits and check their log curvature. We also evaluate primary-source radiative recombination fits for lithium or beryllium as an isolated optional source provider, preserving SI conversion and published validity ranges.
